name: Earth
tagline: Games and apps about our planet
description: Learn the land, the water, the sky and the life of Earth through play. Every project works offline and on slow connections.

principles.title: Works offline
principles.text: Install once, play anywhere. Regular use never needs a connection; content you download stays yours.

principles.title: Light on data
principles.text: A project is a few hundred kilobytes. Pictures and sounds arrive when your connection allows, never as a requirement.

principles.title: Real Earth
principles.text: Real places, real terrain, real sky at the real time. Every fact is sourced; every image is credited.

principles.title: Easy on the eyes
principles.text: Warm colours, generous type, a dark mode and adjustable text size on every page.
